$comment: Researched vehicle data for the Selected Work showroom. STATUS: first-year sales were dropped from the site on 2026-11-01 (PRD 5.2.4, Q13) - sales fields below are a research record only and must not be surfaced. Launch years remain in use. Every figure is sourced in vehicle-data.md. null means no reliable public figure was found - do not substitute an estimate.
salesBasis: First full fiscal year of sales, April-March (Indian FY), domestic unless noted

vehicles.name: Mahindra Maxx
vehicles.notes: Launched 2001 in nine- or ten-seat station wagon form; replaced the Mahindra Armada. Later sold as a pickup (Bolero Maxx Pik-Up is a different, 2022 nameplate - do not conflate).

vehicles.name: Bolero XL
vehicles.notes: Bolero nameplate launched 2000 (April 2000 per Times Now; 4 Aug 2000 per other reports). The XL variant, aimed at the taxi segment with a 9/10-seat layout, appears from 2001 - CarDekho catalogues it as 'Bolero 2001-2010 XL 9 Seater'. Sales were never split out from the Bolero total.

vehicles.name: Xylo
vehicles.salesBasis: FY2009-10 (Apr 2009 - Mar 2010), first full fiscal year
vehicles.notes: Launched 13 Jan 2009 at Nashik; retail sales began March 2009. 3,171 units in the first full month (Mar 2009); 15,000+ in the first six months; 7,800 units in June 2009 alone. FY2009-10 closed at 27,978 units, against 32,062 in FY2010-11. Production 2009-2019.

vehicles.name: Maxximo
vehicles.notes: Greenfield programme: unveiled at Auto Expo 2010, commercially launched 3 Feb 2010, and the first product built at Mahindra's Chakan plant. Launch production 2,000 units/month, scalable to 3,000. Crossed 100,000 domestic units by 2013 and 240,000 across the platform in five years (2015). No first-year figure published. Discontinued 2015.

vehicles.name: Mahindra Jeeto
vehicles.salesBasis: FY2015-16 (Apr 2015 - Mar 2016), first year of sales
vehicles.notes: Launched 23 June 2015 as a modular range of 8 mini-trucks; built at Zaheerabad. Sold a little over 20,569 units in FY2015-16, beating the Tata Ace on price in its first year. 100,000 Jeeto Load units by 2019; 200,000 platform units by 2022.

vehicles.name: Tata Signa
vehicles.notes: Signa range unveiled at SIAM Auto Expo 2016 (Feb 2016) with the 4923.S tractor, 3118.T multi-axle truck and 2518.K tipper; commercial launch announced Sept 2016. The supplied asset shows a Signa 4825.TK, a later variant (c. 2020) - confirm which one the project entry should describe. Tata does not publish model-level sales.
